title: Meta reaches $17B settlement. And, nuclear regulator to abandon radiation safety rule
summary: Meta and the states that sued the company have agreed to a $17 billion settlement. And, nuclear regulators are preparing to abandon a decades-old radiation safety rule.
contentText:
Meta and the states that sued the company have agreed to a $17 billion settlement. And, nuclear regulators are preparing to abandon a decades-old radiation safety rule.

(Image credit: Imen Ben Youssef / Hans Lucas)
